name: OMC
tagline: A closed-loop system that measures and proves the financial value of work shared by people, AI models and agents.
status: Design phase: walking skeleton on synthetic data

demo.title: Qualify a model migration
demo.summary: Watch a confidence bound tighten as paired cases arrive, and end with a signed verdict. The in-browser demo is planned; this page shows a labeled placeholder until it ships.

audience.concern: Switch a model or vendor with evidence that outcomes did not get worse.
See what AI work costs and delivers, in numbers finance can recompute.
Show who or what acted, with what authority, and what human access took place.
Verify statements with the public verifier, schema and test vectors.

highlights.title: Four entry audits
highlights.text: Migration qualification, outcome billing audit and vendor bake-off, action authority audit, and human access and disclosure compliance audit.

highlights.title: Numbers finance can re-run
highlights.text: Statements can be re-derived from signed inputs with a pinned estimator, so a result does not rest on trust.

highlights.title: Bounded risk
highlights.text: A kill switch returns traffic to the baseline, so a trial never leaves you without a safe fallback.

highlights.title: Your data stays in your tenant
highlights.text: The measurement runs in the customer’s tenant; a hosted control plane coordinates it.

verifyIt: Run the demo, then verify its signed statements and hash chain with the standalone verifier and the public test vectors.

buildFromSource.title: Run from source
buildFromSource.intro: OMC is in its design phase and has no packaged release. Run the walking-skeleton demo.
buildFromSource.steps:
git clone https://github.com/DamainRamsajan/Operating-Margin-Controller-
cd Operating-Margin-Controller-
pip install -e ".[dev,spike]"
python scripts/demo.py
buildFromSource.note: Needs Python 3. Results come from synthetic data only.

faq.q: Has OMC been validated on real data?
faq.a: Not yet. Every result so far comes from synthetic worlds with planted ground truth. The repository's limitations page lists what to read before relying on any result.

faq.q: Why was my case held instead of promoted or rejected?
faq.a: The bounds are valid but conservative, so close calls stay on hold until there is more evidence. The 'unclear' scenario in the demo shows this.
Ed25519 only today. Post-quantum signing and transparency-service registration are on the backlog.
